examples.en: I'm going to revise tonight.

dialogue.en: Have you got an exam tomorrow?

dialogue.t: 네, 역사요. 수업 끝나고 복습할 거예요.
dialogue.r: ne, yeoksayo. sueop kkeutnago bokseupal geoyeyo.
dialogue.en: Yes, history. I'll revise after class.
Shall we study in the library?
Yes. The notes deadline is today.

grammar.title: 보통 + 현재 vs 을 거예요

examples.en: I usually leave at seven.
I'm going to save next month.
My shift starts at nine.

mistakes: 인쇄된 시간표에 을 거예요를 쓰지 마세요.

dialogue.en: What time do you usually start?

dialogue.t: 아홉 시요. 다음 달에 바꿀 거예요.
dialogue.r: ahop siyo. daeum dare bakkul geoyeyo.
dialogue.en: The shift starts at nine. I'm going to change it next month.
Why?
I want a shorter commute. That's the goal.
